mechanism_narrative: A low effective federal funds rate compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 120), the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 120.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI level above 190 indicates moderate inflation that supports corporate pricing power and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 190.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2000 thousand units, it signals strong residential investment that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
